text:
jess: quick heads-up — I found a way Dedicated admins can query usage/cost across orgs. looks like an RBAC scoping bug. repro below.

sam: can you paste repro steps?

jess: repro (tested on staging):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.dev/admin/usage?org_id=org-12345&start=2026-02-01&end=2026-02-28"
# returns usage payload for org-99999 if you substitute org_id
```
It should 403 when org_id != token_org but it returns results.

kai: this matches the RBAC policy change from last week — `billing_view` was accidentally granted `resource: "billing/*"` at global scope instead of `resource: "org/{{org_id}}/billing/*"`. cc @sam :eyes:

maria: also noticed our audit logs only record the endpoint and actor, not the requested `org_id`. so we can't tell if this was just a quick scan or wide data exfil. we should log params and the resolved effective_org for every admin read.

security-bot: ALERT: unusual `GET /admin/usage` volume from 3 distinct admin tokens in last 12m — created incident PROD-9876 (auto-detect).

ops-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) remove `billing_view` from default admin group, 2) rotate admin tokens/keys, 3) throttle admin endpoints. who can cut the rollback?

sam: I'll open a tight PR to scope the policy and add an automated test to assert org scoping. linking PR when ready. also filing the incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-9876

jess: uploaded logs and minimal repro to S3: `s3://redwood-incidents/PROD-9876/repro.log`

kai: policy snippet that is wrong: 
```yaml
- role: billing_view
  allow:
    - action: read
      resource: "billing/*"  # should be org-scoped
```
Fix should be: `resource: "org/{{request.org_id}}/billing/*"` and add a policy eval test.

maria: I'll push a small audit-logging change to include `request.params.org_id` and `effective_org` in the next 15m. we need this for the postmortem.

ops-oncall: rotating admin tokens now. notify security@redwood.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4212 — tightening policy + unit test. will also add an integration test to the post-deploy suite.

jess: thanks. Action items: sam (policy PR), kai (rollback + deploy if needed), maria (audit logging patch), ops-oncall (rotate tokens + notify execs). ETA 2 hours. :lock: 

maria: also propose a follow-up: add CI check that prevents `resource: "billing/*"` without org interpolation. I can draft.

sam: agreed. tagging @ciso for visibility and compliance review.

ops-oncall: marking thread as incident channel. updating incident doc: https://redwood.status/prod-9876

jess: will monitor logs for anomalous downloads. ping here if you see anything else.

security-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: temporary mitigation applied (billing_view stripped from default_admin).

kai: once PR is green I'll coordinate canary deploy.

sam: thanks team. follow-up meeting in 30m to review root cause and next steps.
